scripts.build: vite build && node copy-redirects.js && node scripts/write-version.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/vitest.mjs run src/test/unit src/test/integration src/test/regression src/test/api src/test/security
scripts.test:coverage: node scripts/vitest.mjs run src/test/unit src/test/integration src/test/regression src/test/api src/test/security --coverage
